# GEMVC

> Server-agnostic PHP REST API framework (Apache / Nginx / FrankenPHP / OpenSwoole). Four layers: API → Controller → Model → Table/ViewTable. Not Laravel or Symfony.

Version: 5.16.0 (gemvc/library)

## AI must read first

- .cursorrules: Root AI front door (short hard rules)
- docs/ai/INDEX.md: Mandatory AI reading order and hard rules
- docs/ai/CANONICAL.md: Architecture, auth, CRUD, Do/Don't
- docs/ai/CORE_REFERENCE.md: Framework class signatures
- docs/AGENTS.md: Universal agent full brief
- docs/CLAUDE.md: Claude Code entry
- docs/GEMINI.md: Antigravity entry (overrides docs/AGENTS.md on conflict)
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: Philosophy (*why*)

## Docs

- docs/README.md: Human + AI documentation index
- docs/guides/architecture.md: Internals / request flow (*how*)
- docs/guides/ecosystem.md: gemvc/* package map
- docs/guides/api.md: API layer + rate limit (DRIVER apcu/redis/both/none, requireRateLimit*)
- docs/guides/controller.md: Controller + createList
- docs/guides/model.md: Model layer + atomic money transfers (forUpdate)
- docs/guides/database.md: Table, ViewTable, migrate, transactions / forUpdate
- docs/guides/model.md#atomic-money-transfers-pessimistic-lock: beginTransaction + forUpdate + BCMath (not raw PDO)
- docs/guides/installation.md: Install → first API; APCu/Redis for rate-limit drivers
- docs/guides/cli.md: CLI workflows
- docs/guides/security.md: JWT, schema, rate-limit, family trust (requireInternalService / HMAC)
- docs/guides/http-client.md: outbound HttpClient + ServiceCall mesh DX (GEMVC_SERVICES_JSON)
- docs/guides/http-lifecycle.md: Adapters, unified Request, Apache vs Swoole delivery
- docs/guides/openswoole.md: OpenSwoole isolation, pooling, no-die, production FAQ (canonical)
- docs/guides/frankenphp.md: FrankenPHP classic + worker, Caddyfile path security (not .htaccess)
- docs/guides/apm.md: APM tracing
- docs/guides/api-documentation.md: Auto @http docs
